provenance_sequencing: Previously pooled and annual animal PHOTO results and ONE regional-area MODIS 522-pair NDVI result were opened. Source camera-specific MODIS pixels and their association with camera-photo reweighting have not been computed. This is exploratory, not a prospectively untouched dataset or causal design.

source_pins.source: Microsoft Planetary Computer public STAC collection modis-13Q1-061; only MOD13Q1 Terra V061 16-day 250m NDVI

spatial.source_site_coords: Use original source-public normalized UTM camera locations privately inside ephemeral GitHub runner. Output ONLY aggregate counts and taxon/year correlations: NEVER exact camera ID, site coordinates or pixel location.
spatial.satellite_grid: NASA MODIS sinusoidal tiled 250m H21V09 covering public original 1,125km2 Serengeti camera region; if fewer than 80% of original 186 supported source cameras fall within tile, fail HOLD; no pretending other tiles are sampled
spatial.pixel: At each camera source coordinate sample centered 3x3 250m pixels, primary QA=0 good only, at least 6 pixels raw NDVI in [-2000,10000] times 0.0001

date_calendar.original_camera_date_pairs: Exactly the already frozen 24,290 camera-specific photoperiod <=1 minute paired source dates, 2010-2012 December21±k where k=7..180. Original same-site date set MUST replay before NDVI analysis.
date_calendar.ndvi_composite: Latest completed original 16-day Terra composite with end date <= source photograph calendar day, lag <=20 days; if latest scene QA fails do not reach back further.
date_calendar.pair_NDVI: Only include original camera/daylight pair if its site-pixel NDVI has >=6 good pixels on BOTH rising and falling date-aligned composites.
date_calendar.sitecycle_NDVI: For each camera×year, mean of all paired falling-rising NDVI deltas; require >=10 valid source datepairs AND valid fraction >=60% of the original astronomy-pair roster (else siteyear insufficient).
date_calendar.photo_source: Within this NEW NDVI-qualified paired date set only, separately count previous 30-min deduped source photographed events at EXACT same physical camera × year × rising/falling seasonal branch; preserve zero records.
date_calendar.site_taxon_admission: For observational correlations, require >=5 photo records for each focal species on BOTH NDVI-qualified branches at each same camera×cycle; leave others as no source event support (never add pseudo-counts).
date_calendar.year_support: At least 15 qualifying individual physical camera IDs and >=50% of source same-year photographed observations retained on NDVI-qualified roster before showing descriptive correlation for a taxon/cycle.
date_calendar.full_original_species_preservation: Original first output all 43 species labels and all 38,792 total source matched photos MUST be reproduced/verified before any five-taxon new matched-NDVI analysis. Only five previously named focal labels receive exploratory NDVI association summaries, cannot relabel as all-mammal confirmatory.

estimands.independent_covariate: Camera×calendar-cycle local satellite source NDVI delta falling minus rising on only quality-qualified matched astronomy day pairs.
estimands.photo_reweight_outcome: Camera×cycle natural log of (falling matched NDVI-date photo count/rising matched NDVI-date photo count), both >=5, same number matched calendar dates per branch; not actual animal presence/migration or exposure rate.
estimands.within_camera_time_outcome: Camera×cycle falling night-photo fraction minus rising night-photo fraction on NDVI-quality date matched photos; not latent animal night activity.
estimands.descriptive_correlations: Spearman rank correlation for each covariate-outcome in each of three cycles and each of five prelisted taxa, no animal event p-values or region-generalized inference.
estimands.robustness: Leave-one-physical-camera-out min/max of Spearman rho, not confidence interval, undefined for insufficient sites or zero variability.
estimands.numeric_null_coverage: If NDVI QA or source camera-day data fail inclusion, output exact support counts and UNAVAILABLE rather than imputing environmental predictors or broadening site/taxon/time windows.

required_negative_controls: Check every MODIS scene id, start/end, regional first-probe QA and median against FIRST hash-pinned original 83-scene JSON before reading focal-site pixels; if difference, fail hold.
Preserve original 186-source-camera and 24,290 paired calendar count; do not change original dated animal results or previous photo W/B decomposition.
Check 16-day observation age <=20 days and never substitute future composite for missing true satellite imagery.
Original source photo rows and vegetation pixel NDVI are not independent latent animal passage records; camera-hours, model/flash, day zone q unknown.
Report all five taxa and all three cycles including zeros/unavailable/mixed signs; do not select best species by correlation magnitude.
claim_ceiling: Study uses one savanna landscape and physical-camera sites that were selected for photos and detector placement; satellite NDVI at 250m includes woody foliage and is not forage biomass. Even positive NDVI/photo correlation cannot identify movement or mechanism without independently verified device on-hours, q and movement data. No p-values, cross-biome universality, causal rainfall→NDVI→animal mediation.
